invariants.rationale: Method always returns a new List<T> instance, which is never null.
Newly constructed List<T> UI widgets in scene2d.ui are typically not visible by default unless shown explicitly.
A new List<T> instance is created without adding elements, so its size is zero.
When a new List<T> is created and no selection is set, the default selected index is typically -1.
A new List<T> has an empty items collection by default.
